summary: Defines a Media Gateway Control Protocol (MGCP) package for bulk auditing. Base MGCP audits one endpoint at a time. The bulk package lets a Call Agent learn a group's endpoint naming convention, the list of instantiated endpoints, and connection and endpoint state in fewer steps.

eli5.summary: Instead of knocking on every classroom door to ask who is inside, the principal gets one list of all rooms and who is in them. This makes checking a whole group of phone gateways much faster.

questions: how to audit many mgcp endpoints
